sp500_data.recent_snapshot_source: The recent compact snapshot metadata describes the 1993-12-31–2026-11-10 segment as a previously validated FJA/FRED merged snapshot; row-level source lineage and rights have not been fully recorded in this migration manifest.
sp500_data.merge_rule: Use FJA observations strictly before 1993-12-31; retain recent validated compact observations from 1993-12-31 onward; no interpolation or forward-fill.
sp500_data.rights_status: upstream_data_rights_unverified; public redistribution approval required before production release.

drawdown_validation.method: For each configured peak/trough interval, compute the maximum and minimum actual S&P 500 daily closes within the interval and compare dates, percent decline, and configured close values where present.
